hints.title: Two Independent Cases
hints.text: Solve making the array non-decreasing first, then reverse the array to solve making it non-increasing.

hints.title: Slope Trick Formulation
hints.text: For the non-decreasing case, track the inflection points of the convex cost function using a max collection.

hints.title: Adjusting Peaks with Priority Elements
hints.text: When the current element is smaller than the largest seen inflection point, pay the difference and adjust the peak.

hints.title: Slope Trick Heap Implementation

complexity.notes: Slope trick maintains optimal convex breakpoint structure.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard O(n * range) state DP is too slow for values up to 10^3 or larger constraints.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Heap of size up to 2n inflection points.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate solves both directions and applies slope trick or coordinate compression.
